create.title: Create tenant
create.description: Provision a new customer workspace. It stays pending until activated.
create.cardDescription: Provisioning sets up default document settings, branding and a hostname mapping.
create.fieldSlugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Generated from the name when omitted.
create.fieldOwnerHint: An owner invitation is issued; the recipient must accept it to become owner.

detail.transitionNote: Only three transitions exist: pending → active, active → suspended, suspended → active. Nothing moves a workspace automatically, and an overdue arrangement stays active until a person with the suspension permission suspends it, for a recorded reason.
detail.suspensionEffect: Suspension stops new writes and synchronization. The business keeps reading, printing and downloading what it already has, no record and no stored file is deleted, and a device that is offline is refused when it next connects.

actions.activateConfirm: Activate this organisation? Its workspace becomes available to members.
actions.suspendConfirm: Suspend this organisation? New writes and synchronization stop immediately for anything that reaches the server.
actions.suspensionReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this organisation is being suspended
actions.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate this organisation? Workspace access is restored.
actions.reasonRequired: A reason of at least 3 characters is required.
actions.reasonLabel: Reason — recorded in the status history and the audit trail
actions.activateEffect: The workspace opens to its members. Nothing activates a workspace by itself.
actions.activateReasonPlaceholder: Why is this organisation being opened?
actions.suspendEffect: Reading, printing and downloading what the business already has continues. Records and stored files are untouched. A device that is offline keeps its cached data and is refused the next time it connects.
actions.suspendReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this organisation is being suspended
actions.reactivateEffect: Writes and synchronization resume. The status history keeps the suspension and this reactivation, each with its reason.
actions.reactivateReasonPlaceholder: What changed that allows this organisation back?

admin.noAccessDescription: This area is restricted to platform administrators.
admin.listFootnote: These numbers describe workspace configuration only. A business's own records are never read or shown in the provider console.

profile.name: Business name
profile.currencyHint: The workspace default. A branding currency takes precedence on documents.

plan.label: Assign plan
plan.informationalNote: A plan is a label the provider records. It grants no feature, limit or permission, and reading it changes nothing a workspace can do.

domains.slugNoBaseDomain: This deployment has no base domain configured, so the workspace route cannot be shown.
domains.slugInvalid: That slug does not form a valid hostname.
domains.slugWarning: Changing the slug changes the address every member and every installed client uses. Documents already issued keep the numbers they were given.
domains.noHostnames: No custom hostnames. The workspace is reached through its slug route.
domains.removeConfirm: Remove {hostname}? Only the routing entry is removed — the workspace keeps its slug route, its records and its files.
domains.verificationNote: This console records which hostname should route here. It does not verify DNS or certificate ownership, so a listed hostname is not evidence that it resolves.

numbering.example: A number then reads {prefix}{separator}«period»{separator}«sequence», with {padding} sequence digits.
numbering.immutabilityNote: This configures the series only. Issued documents keep the number they were allocated; nothing here renumbers, resets or frees a number.

branding.primaryColorHint: Title bands and headings on the business's documents
branding.primaryForegroundHint: Must reach at least 4.5:1 against the primary colour
branding.contrastWarning: Contrast is {ratio}:1 — the minimum is {min}:1. Adjust the colours before saving so document text stays readable.
branding.currencyHint: Overrides the workspace default on documents. Only currencies this build supports can be saved.
branding.documentLayoutHint: How much of a document is shown at once; templates arrive with the document phase.
branding.logoEmpty: No logo is stored for this workspace yet.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB and 2000x2000 pixels. Uploading replaces the current logo.
branding.logoUploadFailed: The logo could not be uploaded. Check the file and try again.

owner.ownerImmutable: The seat is filled. Ownership moves through a role change inside the workspace; this console does not reassign it.
owner.noOwner: No owner has accepted yet. Name the person who should open this workspace.
owner.pendingWorkspaceNote: The workspace is still pending — which is the state that lets a first owner accept at all.
owner.invitationPending: A pending owner invitation already exists for {email}. Saving again refreshes that invitation instead of adding a second one.
owner.noMailNote: This deployment has no mail transport, so nothing has been emailed and the acceptance link is not shown here. The invitation is stored with only its hash and expires after seven days.

indicators.lastActivityHint: Stamped when the server accepts a write for this workspace — not when someone views a page.
indicators.lastSyncHint: Written by the synchronization transport, which this MVP does not have yet.
indicators.recordUpdatedHint: Any change to the workspace row, including a provider edit. It is not evidence of business activity.
indicators.offlineNote: A device that is offline keeps whatever it cached until it connects again. Suspension takes effect when that device asks to write or synchronize, and the server records the refusal it gives. Nothing here can claim a revocation reached a device any earlier than that.

codes.tenant_suspended: Workspace suspended — writes and synchronization refused
codes.no_membership: No active membership for this account
codes.support_read_only: Support access is read-only — synchronization refused

audit.empty: No audit events recorded for this workspace.
audit.noPermission: This workspace has an audit trail, but your platform role does not include reading it.

preview.placeholderNote: Placeholder shells. They show how the saved branding, business details and configured numbering shape will read once documents exist. The line items, quantities and totals here are examples: nothing has been issued, and no tax is calculated.
preview.noTaxInPreview: Tax is configured with documents, not in a preview
preview.deliverySignatureNote: Delivered quantities and the customer's acknowledgement are recorded separately from invoiced quantities and payments.
